senses.gloss:
m. (-गः)
Association or cohabitation with men.
E.
पुम्, and योग union.

n. (-ङ्गः)
1 The male organ.
2 The masculine gender, (in grammar.)
E.
पुम् male, and लिङ्ग mark.

m. (-षः)
The musk rat.
E.
पुम् male, and वृष a bull.

f. (ली)
A harlot, an unchaste woman.
E.
पुस a man, and चल to go, aff. अच् and ङीष्.

n. (-ह्नं)
The penis.
E.
पुम् male, and चिह्न mark.

r. 10th cl. (पुसयति)
To punish, to pain.

n. (-नं)
The first of the essential ceremonies of Hindū initiation; a religious and domestic festival held on the mother's perceiving the first signs of a living conception.
2 Milk.
E.
पुम् a male, षू to bear, aff. ल्युट्.

n. (-स्त्वं)
1 Semen virile.
2 Manhood, virility.
E.
पुम् man, and त्व aff. of the abstract; also with तल् aff., पुंस्ता f. (-स्ता.)

m. (-कः)
Repeated boiling or cooking.
E.
पुनर्, and पाक dressing.

ind.
Repeatedly, again and again.
E.
पुनर् again, repeated.

f. (-ना)
The Pumpun river in Behar.
E.
पुनर् again, repeated, irr.; perhaps from the meandering course of the river.

m. (-रः)
Repetition of any essential ceremony, as reinvestiture with the sacrificial string of a Brahman, who has forfeited it by unknowingly drinking spirits, &c.
E.
पुनर् again, संस्कार ceremony.

ind.
1 Again.
2 But, on the contrary.
3 Assuredly, certainly.
4 A particle indicating division or change of subject.
E.
पण to praise, अर् aff., and the radical vowel changed to उ.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Come back, returned.
E.
पुनर्, and आगत come.

n. (-नं)
Returning, coming back.
E.
पुनर्, and आगमन coming.

n. (-नं)
Renewing or replacing a consecrated fire.
E.
पुनर्, and आधान placing.

m. (-र्त्तः)
1 Return, revolution.
2 Repeated birth.
E.
पुनर्, and आवर्त्त revolving.

mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति)
1 Returning.
2 Subject to successive births.
E.
पुनरावर्त्त, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Repeated, said over again.
n. (-क्तं)
Tautology, repetition.
E.
पुनर्, and उक्त said.

m. (-न्मा)
A Brahman.
E.
पुनर् again, उक्त said, and जन्मन् birth; whose investiture is called a second birth.

f. (-क्तिः)
Repetition, tautology.
E.
पुनर्, and उक्ति saying.

mfn. (-न्मा-न्मा-न्म)
Re-born, born again.
n. (-न्म)
Regeneration.
E.
पुनर्, and जन्म birth.

m. (-यः)
Liberation, final emancipation, freedom from transmigration.
E.
पुनर्जन्म, and जय victory.

m. (-वः)
A finger nail.
f. (-वा)
Hog weed, (Boerhavia diffusa alata.)
E.
पुनर् again, and नव new.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Re-born, born again.
n. (-वं)
Regeneration.
m. (-वः)
A finger nail.
E.
पुनर् again, and भव being.

m. (-वी)
The sentient soul.
E.
पुनर् again, भव being, and इनि possessive aff.; existing again after the dissolution of one body in another form.

mfn. (-र्भूः-र्भूः-र्भू)
Re-born, regenerated.
f. (-र्भूः)
1 A virgin widow re-married.
2 Re-existence.
E.
पुनर् again, (a wife, &c.) भू being.

n. (-नं)
1 Repeated text or injunction.
2 Saying any thing again.
E.
पुनर्, and वचन speaking.

m. (-सुः)
The seventh of the lunar asterisms, containing according to some authorities two, and to others, four stars; (in this sense it is properly confined to the dual number पुनर्व्वसू, though in the Vedas it is used in the singular.)
2 A name of VIṢṆU.
3 The name of a saint, and grammarian; also KĀTYĀYANA.
4 A name of ŚIVA.
5 Commencement of wealth.
6 A Loka or division of the universe.
E.
पुनर् again, वस to dwell, aff. कु.

m. du. (-सूः)
An asterism: see the last.

n. (-त्रं)
An asterism under which males are procreated.
E.
पु for पुमस्, and नक्षत्र asterism.

m. (-गः)
1 A tree, from the flowers of which a yellowish dye is prepared, (Rottleria tinctoria).
2 A white lotus.
3 Nutmeg.
4 A chief, a head or pre-eminent man.
5 A white elephant.
E.
पुं male, नाग an elephant, or aff. of eminence.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Lost, destroyed.
E.
पू to purify, aff. क्र, deriv. irr; also पूत.
